title: Does GPS Need Internet? No. Here's How It Works
description:
GPS is receive-only: satellites broadcast time and position, and your phone listens. Four satellites fix your position. Satellite clocks gain about 38 microseconds a day from relativity and are corrected.

Sources:
• GPS.gov (archive): Space segment: https://archive.gps.gov/systems/gps/space/
• arXiv: Relativity in navigation satellite systems: https://arxiv.org/abs/gr-qc/0507121
• Ohio State: GPS and relativity (PDF): https://www.astronomy.ohio-state.edu/thompson.1847/1144/gps.pdf
